flask.module_summary: The Flask framework provides a comprehensive WSGI-based toolkit for building web applications, featuring modular routing, session management, template rendering, request-response handling, configuration management, and integrated command-line utilities for development and testing.

json.module_summary: This module provides a robust framework for JSON serialization and deserialization, including extensible support for custom Python types and integrated HTTP response handling within the application.

sansio.module_summary: This module provides a framework-agnostic foundation for building modular web applications through core routing, configuration, and request-handling mechanisms, complemented by blueprints for organizing reusable components and application state.
